project: JARVIS Trader Dashboard — Complete & 24/7 (Tony Stark ready)
description: Finish the jarvis-trader dashboard so every feature, strategy, backtest, number, live chart, and data feed is complete, correct, honest, and online 24/7. The dashboard is already mature (25/35 pages LIVE/MIXED, lightweight-charts + recharts + three.js installed, ~39 live widgets). This project closes the remaining gaps: deploy the trade-review loop, add live price charts where missing, complete/verify the unexamined pages, de-static remaining hardcoded data, harden for 24/7 (pm2 boot persistence + monitoring + remote access), and a unified command pane. Each story = one focused, verifiable change. Dashboard must typecheck clean (tsc --noEmit) and not crash. Engine changes that touch safety-critical files (main.py, risk/) require Amo's [safety-review] tag on the PR.
verification: Per story: tsc --noEmit 0 errors for dashboard changes; engine pytest green for engine changes; the named page/route renders real data or an honest empty state (no crash, no hardcoded-as-live).

userStories.title: 24/7 reliability — pm2 boot persistence + auto-resurrect
userStories.description: As Amo, I want engine, dashboard, bridge, and master-api to survive reboots and crashes automatically so the system is genuinely online 24/7.
acceptanceCriteria: pm2 save run; pm2 startup (or Windows equivalent) configured so processes resurrect on boot — AMO-GATED if it needs admin
All 4 pm2 processes online with sane restart counts
A documented one-command recovery (restart_engine.ps1) verified
Stopped 'jarvis-weekly-tearsheet' explained (cron, expected) or fixed
userStories.notes: Verified+documented in RELIABILITY.md. 4 services online (engine restarts=4 sane), pm2 save done (dump.pm2 exists), tearsheet stopped=expected (weekly one-shot). Gap: no logon `pm2 resurrect` task → won't survive reboot; pm2 startup unsupported on Windows. Ready Amo command provided (Jarvis-PM2-Resurrect logon task, LIMITED, battery flags). Registration AMO-GATED.
